themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks spiked to 36 this week—a 454% increase from the 6.5-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks—suggesting a sudden, localized disturbance pattern that warrants immediate investigation into source and timing.
evidence: 36 street/sidewalk noise complaints this week vs. 6.5 weekly average (z-score: 8.26)
No corresponding Reddit or news coverage suggests unreported local issue
reporting_angles: Map the 36 complaints geographically to identify hot spots (construction site? event venue? new business?)
Interview residents in affected blocks about timing, source, and duration of noise disturbance

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 5 this week—a 1233% increase from the 0.4-per-week baseline—marking the sharpest proportional spike in the district and signaling either a genuine enforcement gap or emerging disorder in a specific location.
evidence: 5 drug activity complaints this week vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.65)
1233% increase is the single largest percentage spike in 311 data
No community board agenda item or council constituent escalation yet—may indicate underreporting
reporting_angles: NYPD precinct interview: what enforcement action or community tip prompted these reports?
Locate the 5 complaints by block; investigate whether they cluster around a single location (park, transit hub, corner)

themes_detail.label: Street Lighting Outages
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints surged to 77 last week—a 193% increase from the 26.2-per-week baseline—indicating a potential citywide or district-specific power or infrastructure issue that has already degraded safety and visibility.
evidence: 77 street light complaints last week vs. 26.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.21)
193% spike is sustained at high volume
Street Light Condition ranks #8 in 90-day top complaints, suggesting chronic but worsening issue
reporting_angles: DOT inquiry: root cause of outages (storm damage, maintenance backlog, equipment failure)?
Cross-reference with Con Edison outage data for the district last week
Interview residents about safety impacts (crime concern, pedestrian accidents) in dark areas

themes_detail.label: Indoor Air Quality Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints jumped to 5 this week—a 400% increase from the 1.0-per-week baseline—a rare and sudden spike that may indicate a HVAC failure, mold outbreak, or industrial emission affecting multiple buildings or a dense residential block.
evidence: 5 indoor air quality complaints this week vs. 1.0 weekly average (z-score: 8.0)
400% spike; represents a rare category in 311 complaint universe
Temporal clustering this week suggests shared cause (weather event, industrial activity, building system failure)
reporting_angles: Map the 5 complaints: are they from one building or a geographic cluster?
DEP or NYC Health Department inquiry: any reported violations, mold inspections, or emissions complaints in South Beach/Dongan Hills this week?

themes_detail.label: Door/Window Breach Reports
themes_detail.summary: Door/window complaints spiked to 5 this week—a 700% increase from the 0.6-per-week baseline—suggesting either a break-in cluster, vandalism wave, or a reporting artifact tied to a single building's security failure.
evidence: 5 door/window complaints this week vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.29)
700% spike; clustering in same week suggests correlated incidents
No Reddit or news coverage; likely localized and unreported to media
reporting_angles: NYPD precinct: any recent burglary or break-in pattern in the district?
Identify the 5 locations: single building (suggests structural/security failure) or dispersed (suggests crime wave)?
